_doc: Lighthouse CI config. Run locally with `npx @lhci/cli@0.14.x autorun` (after `npm run build` so frontend/out exists). The CI workflow at .github/workflows/lighthouse-ci.yml runs the same thing on every PR.

collect._doc-staticDistDir: lhci CLI spawns a local static server against this directory, so the URLs below resolve against the actual production build (frontend/out/) - no deploy hop required, no network flake.
collect._doc-numberOfRuns: 1 run per URL keeps CI minutes low. Lighthouse scores have ~5pt variance run-to-run; bump to 3 if a flaky regression starts ping-ponging the PR gate.

settings._doc-preset: desktop because the studio's primary buyers are gift-shopping on a laptop. Mobile would be more punishing and is worth a follow-up run if you care about the mobile-first index ranking signal.
settings._doc-skipAudits: uses-http2 fires because the local static server is HTTP/1.1; production SWA serves HTTP/2 so this is a false positive.

upload._doc-target: temporary-public-storage uploads the run to lhci's public bucket; results URL works for ~7 days, no signup. PR comment includes the link. Switch to filesystem + GH artifacts later if you want longer retention.

assert._doc: Audit M3: a11y and best-practices are now hard build gates (error). Perf + SEO stay 'warn' - perf has real variance run-to-run and SEO can dip transiently. Individual audits that historically fire false-positive on the SWA static host are exempted below.

assertions._doc-cls-lcp: Individual Core Web Vitals - hard-fail on regressions past the Google 'good' thresholds so we never ship a page that hurts search ranking.
